suggestions: I'm grateful for a pull request that got approved without a single "nit:" comment.
I'm thankful for the rain starting right after I got home, not five minutes before.
I'm grateful for catching the missing semicolon before the client did.
I'm thankful for nasi lemak at 2am tasting just as good as it does at 7am.
I'm grateful for the two minutes of silence before Fajr when even my phone decides to stay quiet.
I'm thankful for a Grab driver who didn't ask why I'm heading to the office on a Saturday.
I'm grateful for a CI pipeline that actually told me what broke instead of just "failed."
I'm thankful for my mom still packing extra rice even though I moved out two years ago.
I'm grateful for payday landing before the credit card bill does, for once.
I'm thankful for the office aircon finally getting fixed after three complaint tickets.
I'm grateful for a senior dev who explained the legacy code instead of just saying "it's complicated."
I'm thankful for the mamak remembering my teh tarik order without me saying a word.
I'm grateful for a sprint that ended with zero carried-over tickets, which basically never happens.
I'm thankful for Friday prayers landing right in the middle of a slow week at work.
I'm grateful for the quiet drive home when the radio actually plays something decent for once.
